date.description: Date of the incident as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if the text does not state a full calendar date.

location.description: Where the incident happened, as written in the text, or null if not stated.

equipment.description: Distinct pieces of equipment involved, as written in the text. Empty if none are named.

severity.description: Severity as stated or clearly implied by the text; unknown if it cannot be determined.

summary.description: One-sentence summary of the incident, at most 300 characters.
